name: Call of the Darkwing's Shadow Bat strikes once with Bat Bite and heals its master (#10614)
contract: Before this fix, bloodmage_darkwing_bat set REACT_DEFENSIVE on the Shadow Bat (50069) and gave it weapon
damage, but no code ever cast Bat Bite 802358: the bat either auto-attacked perpetually or, with no
victim assist available, never acted at all. Live Ascension combat logs (2026-07-13, coa-log-history)
show each Shadow Bat landing exactly one Bat Bite hit, healing its master for the same amount (Bat
Bite's own helper chain 802358 -> 802577 -> 802399, tooltip 'healing you equal to the damage dealt' on
801958), then staying alive and idle until its normal 15 sec duration (SpellDuration 8) expires.
The fix: ShadowBatAI (AscensionBloodmageDarkwing.cpp) casts Bat Bite exactly once at the owner's current
victim when the bat spawns (retrying briefly if no victim is set yet), then sets REACT_PASSIVE and never
acts again; spell_ascension_bloodmage_bat_bite (SpellScript on 802358) heals the master for the hit's
final post-mitigation damage via 802399, cast by the bat itself so 802399's native TARGET_UNIT_MASTER
resolves to the owner (Spell::EffectImplicitTarget), only for bats created by 801958
(UNIT_CREATED_BY_SPELL), matching 802578's tooltip (BasePoints 5, 6-bat variant) carrying no heal clause.
Metric limitation: spell_heal_count/spell_heal_total (CoAGameplayTest.cpp) default their caster filter to
the player or, with pet:true, Player::GetPetGUID(); the Shadow Bat is SummonProperties 61 (Category ALLY,
not SUMMON_CATEGORY_PET), so Minion::IsGuardianPet() is false and it is never placed in that pet slot, so
no heal-metric selector can name it as caster. The heal is therefore proven indirectly: the Bloodmage's
current health (regeneration disabled, fixtured low with max headroom) rises once, exactly when
spell_damage_count/spell_damage_total for 802358 with entry 50069 as caster (which IS supported) shows
the bite landed, and never again afterward. spell_damage_count/entry is GetOwnedCreature(player, entry)
backed and unaffected by the pet-slot gap. pet_melee_swings with entry 50069 stays zero throughout,
proving no auto-attack ever occurred either.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture a low current health with headroom so the Bat Bite heal is visible and never overheals away
SETUP: the fixtured health took effect
Give the Bloodmage a current victim before summoning: the bat bites the owner's victim
SETUP: the Shadow Bat is present
DISCRIMINATING: the Shadow Bat landed exactly one Bat Bite
DISCRIMINATING: the master's health rose once the bite landed
Health and Bat Bite damage count right after the single bite
The bat is still alive right after its strike
Give the bat several seconds to (incorrectly) re-engage, well inside its 15 sec duration
The bat is still alive and present, not despawned early
DISCRIMINATING: no further Bat Bite after the first strike
DISCRIMINATING: no further heal after the first strike (no regeneration, no other damage source)
DISCRIMINATING: the Shadow Bat never auto-attacked
